title: Round 13 (vs Haiku's round 1): a red pipe on a plate
model: Skippy Core's coder (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, MTP, Q8) as a vanilla agent (Claude Code with purple's system prompt, an empty setup, effort high, a 131K window) plus purple's generic help: the eyes, the stop gate's work check (MineBench's runtime as the checker, the renderer as the viewer, an 80K output-token budget), its fix-the-worst-fault loop, and the reference (three real photos found before the run, a list of what they all share, and every review scoring the build against them; 8 of 10 ends the loop)
verdict: Haiku won, blind. The coder's build is a jumble round a giant red pipe on a grey plate, across its rails; Haiku's a steam train with three coaches and smoke. The loop sent it back five times, scores 3 to 4 of 10, four of them for the same fault: no wheels.
